text:
sara_devex: Heads up — ran into an SDK vs REST parity issue that breaks retries and auth for some customers on Private deployments. Repro + notes below.

bob_sdk: which SDK/version and which endpoint?

sara_devex: Node SDK v0.8.2 and Python v0.8.2, endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Two separate issues: param/field drift, and different default retry/auth behavior.

devon_qa: I can repro locally against a Private sandbox. curl -> success, SDK -> 401 or no retry on 429.

sara_devex: Minimal curl repro (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private.example.api/redwood/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b", "input":"hi", "retry_on":[429,503], "max_retries":3}'
```

sara_devex: Equivalent Node SDK call using docs: 
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-13b', input: 'hi', retries: 3 }); // <-- in SDK docs we show `retries`
```

sara_devex: Observed behavior: curl respects retry_on / max_retries header/body and retries on 429/503. Node SDK does NOT retry on 429 by default (immediately surfaces error). Also the SDK accepts `retries` but it maps to client-side backoff only for HTTP 5xx, not 429.

bob_sdk: Hmm. Two things: 1) naming mismatch (`retry_on` vs `retries`) and 2) SDK policy differs for 429. We intentionally treated 429 as non-idempotent for some streaming calls, but generation should be idempotent.

mike_infra: Another wrinkle — Private deployments can be configured to expect an API key header `X-Redwood-API-Key` instead of Bearer Authorization. SDK autoinserts Authorization: Bearer which the private control plane may reject -> 401. That explains some reports.

anna_product: We have onboarding doc that says "SDK supports retries via max_retries" — looks like docs and REST/ctl naming drift. cc @bob_sdk we need one canonical source.

devon_qa: Logs from failing SDK run: 
```
HTTP 401 Unauthorized - missing X-Redwood-API-Key
Request failed with status 429: rate_limit_exceeded (no retry attempted)
```

bob_sdk: Thanks. Action items I can take:
- Add explicit mapping so SDK honors server-side `retry_on`/`max_retries` when present in request body/headers.
- Expose `retry_on` option in SDK client config (array of status codes).
- Make default behavior: treat 429 as retryable for non-streaming generation/embedding calls.

mike_infra: For Private deployments we'll also add detection: if server responds with 401 and a header `x-expected-api-header: X-Redwood-API-Key`, surface a clearer error and suggest setting `apiKeyHeaderName` in SDK config.

anna_product: Also update quickstart snippets in docs/quickstart to use `X-Redwood-API-Key` example for private and clarify `retries` vs `retry_on`.

sara_devex: Quick patch suggestion for SDK usage in interim (Node):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY, apiKeyHeaderName: 'X-Redwood-API-Key', retryOn: [429,503], maxRetries: 3 });
await client.generate(...)
```

devon_qa: I'll open a regression test that compares curl vs SDK behavior for: 200 success path, 429 then retry -> success, 503 backoff, and 401 due to header mismatch.

bob_sdk: Great — I'll file the SDK bug and link test cases. Patch ETA: tomorrow morning, release candidate Tuesday.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sdk/node v0.8.3-rc1 -> canary (dev) at 2026-03-22T08:00:00Z :rocket:

sara_devex: Thanks y'all. Can we also add a short troubleshooting blurb in first-run errors for Private: "If you see 401, check apiKeyHeaderName and whether your control plane expects X-Redwood-API-Key instead of Authorization: Bearer". Saves support tickets. :thumbsup:

bob_sdk: added to PR description.

anna_product: I'll update docs + changelog after RC is promoted.

devon_qa: Filing internal ticket #DEVEX-1892 with repro and logs.

sara_devex: closing loop here, will validate tomorrow after RC. Thanks!
